summary: Performs circular correlation analysis and visualization to compare neural bump phase against scene orientation across pre-learning, learning, and post-training phases.
use_when: plot bump phase versus scene orientation
calculate neural mapping slope for learning epoch
compare bump phase to scene orientation across experimental epochs
analyze neural representation shift during spatial learning
verify bump-scene mapping with mod 2pi transformation
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
